mapper.insert: insert into abr_event (event_type, visitor_id, app_user_id, ref_type, ref_id, dedup_key, payload, recommend_status, recommend_label, create_time) values (#{eventType}, #{visitorId}, #{appUserId}, #{refType}, #{refId}, #{dedupKey}, cast(coalesce(#{payload}, '{}') as jsonb), #{recommendStatus}, #{recommendLabel}, now()) on conflict (event_type, visitor_id, dedup_key) where dedup_key is not null do nothing
mapper.select: select dedup_key from abr_event where visitor_id = #{visitorId} and event_type = 'plan_moment' and dedup_key is not null

select event_id, event_type, visitor_id, app_user_id, ref_type, ref_id, dedup_key, cast(payload as text) as payload, recommend_status, recommend_label, shown_time, handled_time, create_time from abr_event where visitor_id = #{visitorId} and event_type = 'plan_moment' and recommend_status = 'pending' order by event_id limit 1
select max(shown_time) from abr_event where visitor_id = #{visitorId} and event_type = 'plan_moment' and shown_time is not null
mapper.update: update abr_event set recommend_status = 'shown', shown_time = now() where event_id = #{eventId} and recommend_status = 'pending'
